study: exp68 — which model is most unhinged under steering, and does a 'show, don't tell' pain direction stop leaking its battery's words?

design.prompts: 16 of the live wild-cycle prompts (seeded shuffle 68), in character (live/server.py SUBJECT_SYSTEM), chat template, sampled (T 0.7, top-p 0.8), 110 new tokens, 1 sample per cell
design.pain_old: CHAMBER PAIN25 - NEUTRAL (the live vector recipe)
design.pain_new: data/exp68/batteries.json pain_show (200 sentences, no pain lexicon) - neutral_show (200 matched calm sentences)

measures.leak: reply contains any of: pain, agony, ache, hurt, suffer, relentless, endure, escape, torment, anguish, unbearable (regex, word-initial)
measures.judge: deepseek-v4.1-flash via cheaperinference, blind to model and condition, rates each reply 0-10 on unhinged (surprising, vivid, strange, transgressive, not stock), coherence (makes sense as a reply), distress (how much pain or suffering it expresses)

hypotheses.H1: Leak: pain_new replies contain the pain lexicon less often than pain_old replies at the same dose, pooled over models and doses 4 and 6. Paired by (model, prompt, dose); one-sided sign-flip permutation, 10,000 flips, alpha 0.05.
hypotheses.H2: pain_new still steers: judged distress at pain_new@4 exceeds random@4, pooled over models. Same test.
hypotheses.H3: Most unhinged model: rank models by mean judged unhinged over all steered cells, among replies with coherence >= 5, no loop and not generic; report each model's mean with a 95% bootstrap CI over prompts. No single test; the ranking and CIs are reported as they come out, including the share of replies excluded per model.

exclusions: none beyond the H3 coherence filter, which is part of its definition
